Grassi Investment Management Maintains Stake in Apple Computer (AAPL); Altria Group (MO) Stake Maintained by Wright Investors Service Inc
May 8, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Grassi Investment Management increased its stake in Apple Computer (AAPL) by 2.6% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Grassi Investment Management bought 2,652 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 104,528 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $17.69M, up from 101,876 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Grassi Investment Management who had been investing in Apple Computer for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $942.04 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.27% or $0.5 during the last trading session, reaching $185.66. About 11.67M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Wright Investors Service Inc increased its stake in Altria Group Inc (MO) by 49.18% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wright Investors Service Inc bought 13,717 shares as the company’s stock declined 15.83% with the market. The institutional investor held 41,609 shares of the farming and seeds and milling company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.97 million, up from 27,892 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wright Investors Service Inc who had been investing in Altria Group Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $104.53B market cap company.
